title: Unified Corporate Live Streaming: Connecting corporate communication through a full live broadcast system
image1Description: Controlling the filming, editing, and streaming system via Microsoft Teams

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: In an organization with branches spread across the country, communicating internal activities for all employees to know and participate in at the same time is very important. I was assigned to take care of the Live Stream system for company activities. The main goal was to break the limits of location and create a smooth viewing experience as if every employee were sitting in the same room (Inclusive Experience) from the start to the end of the project.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I was responsible for the full Production system (End-to-End), from designing the image and sound system structure inside the event room (On-site) to managing the Streaming system via Microsoft Teams to send signals to various branches. Additionally, I held the position of Content Creator to record and edit videos to be used as main public relations media for the event, helping to increase interest and making the event content professional.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The important challenge was managing the stability of the Real-time image and sound signals. I had to work with the corporate Network system to ensure that many people watching at the same time would not cause technical problems. Also, I had to solve immediate problems regarding Audio Feedback and syncing the images and slides to match the content the speaker was presenting, so that both online and on-site viewers received the most accurate information.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: This Live Stream system helped employees at various branches access company activities 100%, significantly increasing employee Engagement. From this work, I developed skills as a Video Director and gained a deep understanding of Hybrid Event systems, which are essential skills in the Digital Transformation era. This makes me confident in setting up complex multimedia communication systems in the future.
